title: Compress Run
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. `items` is a list of strings. Group consecutive equal values. Return a list of `[value, count]` pairs. A new group starts when the value changes. An empty list returns an empty list. Non-consecutive duplicates are separate groups.
hints: If the list is empty, return an empty list.
Track the current value and its count.
Flush the open group when the value changes, and flush once more at the end.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Run-length encoding is one pass with a single open group.

editorial: Run-length encoding is one pass with a single open group. Comparing each element to the previous one avoids a nested scan. Values that match later, after a different value, start a new group. That is what consecutive means.
